scope: Development-only mechanism discrimination for RK39 failure: objective-scale normalization and short-budget limits, with external-seeded local-search diagnostics. No functional, untouched, time-matched, generator-training, or external-SOTA claim.
observed_before_new_outcomes: RK39 search used raw weighted-sum utilities. The existing C01H6.8b.1 calibration has CAI scale 0.07928478595724608 and negative-MFE scale 35.700003051757804, so raw objective units can dominate the search independently of initialization or budget. No RK40 outcomes have been generated or read.
population: The same 18 development records as RK39; no untouched24, functional untouched, MAGE test, Ribo test, or assay labels.
accepted_baseline_arm: raw_random_b11 from independently verified RK39 hill_climbing runs; not regenerated or selected by outcome

initialization.random: Exact RK39 protein-only first-codon template and seeded random synonymous initialization; native CDS is used only to translate the protein and is then discarded; terminal TAA is fixed.
initialization.external: The first LinearDesign-11 actual DNA sequence in frozen matrix order for that record; no outcome-based external-sequence selection. External-seeded arms are mechanism diagnostics, not independent CodonFlow searches.

normalization.raw: SimpleSearch(normalization=None), exactly reproducing RK39 raw weighted-sum utility.
normalization.calibrated: SimpleSearch(normalization=(frozen.reference,frozen.scale)); native-source development calibration is intentionally read before search to diagnose scale mismatch. These arms are not common-input or external-SOTA comparisons.
normalization.evaluation: Every arm and every LinearDesign actual point is evaluated with the same frozen per-record calibration after sequence generation.

budget_rule: Each previously unscored legal synonymous sequence consumes one unique-scorer budget. Budget 1 is the initial state. Long trajectories must reproduce the accepted short trajectory point-for-point when initialization, normalization, and seed are identical.

endpoint_definitions.best_normalized_weighted_utility: Maximum over all real points through the arm budget of dot((objectives-reference)/scale, weights); one sequence contributes once, so adding output cardinality cannot inflate the endpoint.
endpoint_definitions.best_single_point_normalized_hv: Maximum over all real points through the arm budget of prod(max((objectives-reference)/scale,0)); a single-point hypervolume with zero origin, with no multi-sequence archive advantage.

primary_families.question: Does correcting objective-scale mismatch improve the original 11-call random-initialized search?
Does increasing the original raw random-initialized search from 11 to 101 real scorer calls improve best-sequence quality?

statistics.unit: one record; arithmetic mean of its three seeds before paired inference
statistics.ci_method: two-sided percentile paired bootstrap of record-level mean effects
statistics.p_value: two-sided paired sign-flip with plus-one correction, capped at 1
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over the two primary endpoints within each of the two independently named primary families
statistics.family_success_rule: Both endpoints require 95% CI lower bound >0, family-Holm p<0.05, and positive mean effects for every individual seed; otherwise that mechanism family is not supported.

diagnostics: calibrated_random_b101 minus raw_random_b101: normalization at long budget
calibrated_random_b101 minus calibrated_random_b11: budget within calibrated search
raw_external_b11 minus raw_random_b11: external initialization under raw utility
calibrated_external_b11 minus calibrated_random_b11: external initialization under calibrated utility
LinearDesign-11 actual-set best-single metrics and first-k HV/NED: descriptive reference only
dense internal anytime AUC and unequal-cardinality terminal full-set HV/NED: descriptive internal diagnostics only; external dense remains null

execution.order: benchmark FASTA order, then seed ascending, then protocol new-arm order
execution.resume: skip only byte-stable completed run JSON with matching protocol/input/initial-state/budget identity; never accept partial output

allowed_conclusion: A development-only causal-design-style factorial mechanism diagnostic of search normalization, budget, and initialization under frozen proxy objectives. Positive internal contrasts do not establish external SOTA or functional efficacy.
forbidden_conclusion: No unified time-matched ranking, common-input claim for calibrated/external-seeded arms, functional effectiveness, untouched generalization, full seven-method dense matrix, external SOTA authorization, generator improvement, RK-G1 closure, or manuscript-submittable claim.
